content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only “item 261” without transaction or co-purchase data.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 261. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
